metadata.title: Human PD Cingulate GeoMx
metadata.description: Segments were captured from specific cortical layers of Parkinson's disease cases capturing whole transcriptomes from neurons positive for Lewy bodies, or negative for Lewy bodies using the GeoMx WTA platform.
